pr_title: GameEngine: define conversational AI Studio architecture
pr_body:
## Summary

- adds Proposed ADR 0131 for the conversational AI Studio and governed agent runtime
- defines proposal/run semantics, provider and model boundaries, permissions, code workspace, asset acquisition, persistence, and completion gates
- registers ADR 0131 in the ADR index

## Validation

Documentation-only change; Windows Validation should classify this as docs mode.
